name: excelsior
description: A spreadsheet engine built from scratch, fast enough to train a neural network inside its cells.
author: Aamod Bhatt

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p packages/doc && tsc -p packages/nn2sheet && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
scripts.capture: node --import tsx scripts/capture.mts runs/frames docs/assets && node --import tsx scripts/make-gif.mts runs/frames docs/assets/training.gif 1100 7
